name: Radolfzell am Bodensee (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and yellow, charged above the centre with the city arms of Radolfzell am Bodensee (a red lion on yellow and a red cross on white).
history: Municipal flag of Radolfzell am Bodensee; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
